body.statement: Freidling, Zhao, and Gao's Proposition~1 establishes conditional superuniformity and selective type-I-error control for their selective randomization \(p\)-value under the stated adaptive randomization and imputability conditions.

attestation.note: The orchestrator directive supplied the Proposition 1 validity scope; the stable primary-source handles are recorded in place of a verbatim transcription.
